The '''2014–15 [[Super League Greece]]''' was the 79th season of the highest tier in league of [[Football in Greece|Greek]] [[Association football|football]] and the ninth under its current title. The season began on 23 August and ended on 11 May 2015. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 42nd Greek title. The league comprises sixteen teams from the 2013–14 season and two promoted from the [[2013–14 Football League (Greece)|2013–14 Football League]].

==Teams==
Two teams were relegated from the [[2013–14 Super League Greece|2013–14 season]]. [[Apollon Smyrnis F.C.|Apollon Smyrnis]] and [[Aris Thessaloniki F.C.|Aris]] would play in [[Football League (Greece)|Football League]] for the 2014–15 season.

Two teams were promoted from the [[2013–14 Football League (Greece)|2013–14 Football League]], champions [[Niki Volos F.C.|Niki Volos]] and [[PAE Kerkyra|Kerkyra]]. [[Niki Volos F.C.|Niki Volos]] were promoted back to the top level for the first time in 48 years.

==Play-offs==
In the play-off for Champions League, the four qualified teams play each other in a home and away [[Round-robin tournament|round robin]]. However, they do not all start with 0 points. Instead, a weighting system applies to the teams' standing at the start of the play-off mini-league. The team finishing fifth in the Super League will start the play-off with 0 points. The fifth placed team's end of season tally of points is subtracted from the sum of the points that other teams have. This number is then divided by five.{{cn|date=May 2015}}
